# Loghub fixture excerpts

These 40-line excerpts were selected from the public
[Loghub](https://github.com/logpai/loghub) 2k datasets at the commit recorded
in `provenance.json`. IP addresses, UUIDs, and email addresses were replaced
with placeholders.

The excerpts are parser fixtures, not application assets and are not included
in release packages. Retain upstream attribution and follow Loghub's dataset
usage and citation requirements.
